subject: Ent access sequencing: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists & service accounts
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@metropac.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ent access kickoff — sequencing SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists, service accounts

Hi Claire / MetroPac team,

Thanks for the kickoff earlier — excited to get MetroPac onto Redwood. To keep the onboarding low-risk for your engineering and security teams, we've sketched a recommended sequencing for enterprise access controls. High level proposal: 

- Phase 1 (Preflight): SSO (SAML) test integration in our staging tenant, attribute map validation, create 2 test users.
- Phase 2 (Directory sync): SCIM onboarding (read/write off by default), confirm admin sync user and service account permissions.
- Phase 3 (Network controls): IP allowlist for production endpoints and preprod dry-run; coordinate egress requirements.
- Phase 4 (Service identity): Provision service accounts for automated jobs and monitoring; pin org policies (role scoping, session length).

Ask from your side to help us schedule the technical window: 
1) SAML metadata (IDP XML) and a test user (email).
2) SCIM admin account (or OAuth credentials) and contact for your identity team.
3) IP ranges (CIDR) you can apply to allowlist Redwood's prod IPs.
4) Names for service accounts you plan to create and any org policies we should be aware of.

Proposed cutover window for production allowlist: Mar 29 — Apr 2 (we'll do a canary on Mar 30). If that doesn't work, propose two alternate weeks.

Attached: cs-onboard-mpac-checklist.xlsx (installation checklist).

Next steps: If MetroPac can share the SAML metadata and point person for SCIM by EOD Thu (Mar 18), we can lock the preprod tests for the week of Mar 22.

Thanks — I'll coordinate resources from Redwood (Monica will own IP playbooks, Jonas SAML testing, Karthik SCIM/service accounts).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@metropac.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@metropac.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ent access kickoff — sequencing SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists, service accounts

Ben — thanks, this plan looks sensible. Quick updates from our side: 

- I've attached our SAML metadata (mpac-saml-metadata.xml) and shared it to the Drive folder you listed.
- SCIM will be handled by our Identity team (Sanjay is looping in) — Sanjay, can you share the admin service account or client credentials?
- IP allowlisting: our network team is conservative — we typically require fixed prefixes (no dynamic egress ranges). Can Redwood provide a small set of static egress IPs for prod?
- Service accounts: we'll create two initially: mpac-redwood-ci and mpac-monitoring.

Availability: Sanjay and I can do SAML smoke tests next week (Mar 22–24). The production allowlist window Mar 29 — Apr 2 works for us if we confirm static IPs by next Friday.

Question: Do you recommend SCIM write permissions during ramp, or keep write disabled until we complete manual validation?

Thanks,
Claire Nguyen
VP Engineering, MetroPac Solutions

Attachment: mpac-saml-metadata.xml
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ent access kickoff — sequencing SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists, service accounts

Team — copying the thread into a technical plan. Quoting Claire's ask re: static IPs.

Action items I propose: 
- Jonas: validate SAML metadata and produce an attribute map (email, name, groups). Create two preprod test users on Redwood staging and run SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. Target: start Mon Mar 22, complete by Wed Mar 24.
- Karthik: prepare SCIM test harness and advise on recommended permission model. My recommendation: start with SCIM read-only, run reconciliation checks for 48 hours, then enable incremental write for group memberships during a controlled window.
- Monica (me): coordinate IP allowlist cadence with network team and provide the exact IP set we need to allow from Redwood. I'll ask infra for a /28-ish static set for prod; if that's not acceptable, we'll propose region-based endpoints.

Tentative timeline: 
- Mar 18: receive SAML metadata and SCIM contact (as Ben requested) — Claire confirmed.
- Mar 22–24: SAML smoke & attribute map.
- Mar 25–26: SCIM reconciliation in preprod (read-only).
- Mar 29: Prod allowlist change and canary traffic (1% test tenants).

I'll attach the attribute map template and include it in the Drive link. Also note: MetroPac's requirement for "fixed prefixes" is compatible — Monica to confirm exact CIDRs by Mar 18 so their network can schedule the ACL change with change window team.

Monica
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Access Controls
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@metropac.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ent access kickoff — sequencing SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists, service accounts

Claire / team — I've reviewed the mpac-saml-metadata.xml and attached a preliminary sso-attribute-map.yaml that maps the MetroPac assertion attributes to Redwood attributes. A few notes: 

- We require email (NameID or mail attribute) and group list for RBAC mapping. If NameID is transient, please include mail attribute.
- For group sync: we'll do a group membership snapshot during SCIM read-only and validate there are no unexpected privileged groups.
- Test accounts: please provide two staging users (email addresses) — I'll run SP and IdP flows mid-day Mon Mar 22 and share screenshots and SAML traces.

Attachment: sso-attribute-map.yaml

Jonas Weber
Identity Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@metropac.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@metropac.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Ent access sequencing — confirmed dates and next steps

Claire / Sanjay — quick summary and owners so we all have the same playbook: 

- SAML: Jonas will run staging tests Mon Mar 22. MetroPac to provide two staging accounts by EOD Thu Mar 18. (Owner: Jonas)
- SCIM: Karthik will run reconciliation in preprod Mar 25–26 (read-only). MetroPac to supply SCIM admin credentials by Mar 18. We recommend keeping write disabled until after reconciliation and manual review. (Owner: Karthik)
- IP allowlist: Monica will supply Redwood's prod static IP set by Mar 18; MetroPac will schedule ACL change for Mar 29. Canary traffic Mar 30. (Owner: Monica)
- Service accounts: MetroPac will create mpac-redwood-ci and mpac-monitoring and share principal names; Redwood will restrict scopes to necessary APIs only.

Links / artifacts: SAML metadata and attribute map present in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1X-Onboard-MPAC. DocuSign MSA is queued here if you'd like to sign prior to prod roll: https://app.docusign.com/samples/DocuSign-msa-7842

If this summary is good, we'll treat the timeline above as committed and spin up the technical runbooks. Claire — can you confirm the two staging users and SCIM creds by EOD Thu?

Thanks — Ben
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
